lines.en: The wood smells of a stream.
Above the canopy, no one reaches.
My shadow falls on the vines.

lines.zh: 香蕉叶上的热气托着我。
lines.en: Heat off the banana leaves lifts me.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇得酸，还是往前飘。
lines.en: My wings ache, and I drift on.
A clearing in the trees. Good wind.
I know the jungle's night paths.
I slip through a gap in the trees.
Hugging the bark, I drift slowly.
Jungle nectar is the sweetest.
Slow beats carry me farther.
I hug the vines lower.
One loop, then back to the flowers.
Even against the wind, I move on.
The wood is thick—I fly sideways.
Through the jungle, I drift along.
No wind—I can't be bothered.
Time to head back to my branch nest.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在树影里最亮。
lines.en: My wings glow brightest in tree shadow.
Gripping the vine, my feet go numb.
The thunder over the canopy is near.

lines.zh: 我在等一阵能抬翅的风。
lines.en: I wait for a wind that can lift my wings.
This height is perfect for dozing.
A short rest on the vine—just short.
Someone's stepping on leaves below.

lines.zh: 丛林里这么多花，我挑一朵。
lines.en: So many flowers in this jungle — I pick one.
woods has this one perk.
Wings closed on my back, like a leaf.
The light behind you catches me.

lines.zh: 二十一色里，我是最大的一只。
lines.en: Of twenty-one colors, I am the largest.
Birdwing patterns mark my wings.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀，在丛林的光里。
lines.en: My wings in the jungle light.
Let me rest on your shoulder a moment.
Is that long stick a flower?
I land on your shoulder to look.
The name's Birdwing Butterfly, remember.

lines.zh: 丛林里二十一种蝴蝶，我是一种。
lines.en: Of twenty-one jungle butterflies, I'm one.

lines.zh: 丛林里的蝴蝶，只飘不落。
lines.en: A jungle butterfly only drifts, never settles.
The wing's not broken—I can still fly.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的鳞粉掉了一把。
lines.en: A handful of wing scales came off.
My wing's knocked askew—I'll fly crooked.

lines.zh: 下手这么重，鳞粉都飞了。
lines.en: Such a heavy hand — my scales flew off.
These big wings can beat twice more.
I'll retreat to the canopy—don't follow.
Not the wing base—that hurts most.
The birdwing's wings edge aside.
The pattern on my wing is torn.
The gold edge of my wing is rubbed off.
Even the sweat on your palm is sweet.
Don't shake—your hands scare me.

lines.zh: 那朵花的蜜，我只舔一下。
lines.en: Just one lick of that flower's nectar.
Give it to me and I'll land on your hand.
Drop a bit of that flower.
Sweet rot—I can't resist it.

lines.zh: 大翅膀扇起来，我追上你。
lines.en: My big wings beat as I catch up.
Don't close your hand—hold it out.
My wings are thinner than petals.
Ripe fruit fumes make me dizzy.

lines.zh: 丛林的树太密，我绕不开。
lines.en: The jungle is too dense. I can't get around.
I flew too fast and hit a vine.

lines.zh: 丛林里的这对翅膀，太大了。
lines.en: These wings are almost too big for the jungle.
My wingspan is wider than your head.
Whose vine is strung across here?
I'm this big—didn't you see me?
Your shoulder knocked my wing askew.

lines.zh: 我的路线呢，被这棵树挡了。
lines.en: Where is my route? This tree blocks it.
Steady — don't beat those wings wildly.
Knocked silly, I circle twice to recover.

lines.zh: 丛林里最好看的，就是你。
lines.en: The prettiest thing in the jungle is you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀，在丛林里最好认。
lines.en: In the jungle, my wings are easy to know.
Wing to wing—closer still.

lines.zh: 翅膀一拍，花粉撒了一路。
lines.en: One wingbeat scatters pollen behind me.
Wings folded, I land on a blossom.
Come back to my canopy nest.

lines.zh: 我们的翅，拍在一个点上。
lines.en: Our wings beat at the same point.
Circle this tree and do not bump it.
The highest branch is saved for you.

lines.zh: 落在我旁边吧，翅膀别合。
lines.en: Land beside me, wings still open.
Six feet can hold it.

lines.zh: 丛林里，我的翅膀比叶子大。
lines.en: In the jungle my wings outsize the leaves.
One more treasure under my wing.

lines.zh: 翅边擦过一片叶子，很响。
lines.en: My wing edge rustled loudly against a leaf.
This leaf is nest material—mine.
Just what my nest lacks.
Wings folded, it goes into my claws.

lines.zh: 丛林的花那么高，我得飞上去。
lines.en: The jungle blooms grow high; I must fly up.
This fruit has a strange shape.
Who dropped it? Good for my nest.
These compound eyes have you.
Dropping from above is fastest.
The wind turned—now.
Out of nectar—I can't wait.
Look up if you like—I'm here.
In the tree shadow, I see you.
One cry, then I strike.

lines.zh: 我这翅膀，是鸟翼一样的形状。
lines.en: My wings are shaped like a bird's.
This gust will push me down nicely.
The jungle is dense. I drift where I like.
I follow the heat you leave.
In the jungle, my wings are the slowest.
Any slower and the nectar dries.
In the jungle, my wings are the widest.
I'm in the canopy, always watching.

lines.zh: 丛林树冠下，我一闪一闪的。
lines.en: Beneath the canopy I flicker in and out.
One loop around the tree, then down.
Hiding in a hollow won't help—my wings are wide.

lines.zh: 我在树冠上数你的步子。
lines.en: Up in the canopy, I count your steps.
I skim just over your head.

lines.zh: 丛林里二十一种蝴蝶，我是其中一种。
lines.en: Twenty-one butterflies in this mod. I'm one.
I drift and settle on a flower.
My long wing sweeps past your shoulder.
I drift along the jungle light.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀是黑的，边上一圈金。
lines.en: Black wings with a gold rim.

lines.zh: 说了从树上下来，就下来。
lines.en: I said I'd come down—here I am.
My wingbeat caught your face!
The scales on my wings will choke you.
My big wings have you covered!
This wingbeat lands heavy.
My petals is still here.
Where are the flowers I was promised?
First sight of the jungle's light.
This sky is mine now.

lines.zh: 翅膀还没展开，我先站着。
lines.en: Wings not yet spread, I stand still.
My wings aren't dry—I'll wait.

lines.zh: 我飘着，不落在任何一片叶上。
lines.en: I drift, never settling on a leaf.

lines.zh: 我从叶背底下爬出来了。
lines.en: I've crawled out from under the leaf.
They call me Birdwing Butterfly.
I like the jungle's dark.
Who lit that fire?

lines.zh: 我从花瓣上滑下去，落得慢。
lines.en: I slip off the petal and fall slowly.
Wet wings, and I sink.
The blast flipped my wings.
The arrow came through the trees!
My wings are going numb.
My stomach is louder than my wings.
Lightning struck—my wing edge is scorched.

lines.zh: 在虚空里，翅膀一点风都碰不到。
lines.en: In the void my wings meet no wind at all.
